comment: BNpcBase 9020, the director's helper (layout 0, level 1, 44 HP, never seen): twelve of them in Cape Westwind, on the boss's spot until the director puts one somewhere to cast. 28865 (3.7 s cast, no target: 810 and 832), 28869 (7.7 s: 1015, 1105; 913 parried), 28880 (0.2 s on the player: Knockback 17), 28882 (2.7 s: 448).
